title: Graphs from quadratic forms and vector spaces over finite fields
summary: Let $q$ be an odd prime power, let $n\ge 2$, and let $V\subsetneq \mathbb F_{q^n}$ be a proper $\mathbb F_q$-vector subspace. Given a nonzero quadratic form $Q(X,Y)\in \mathbb F_{q^n}[X,Y]$, we consider the graph $Γ(Q,V)$ that naturally arises from the condition $Q(X,Y)\in V$. We determine all quadratic forms $Q$ for which $Γ(Q,V)$ is undirected for every $V$. Besides the case $Q(x,y)=XY$, studied earlier by the second author, this essentially leads to the forms $X^2\pm Y^2$ and the family $Q_b(X, Y):=X^2+bXY+Y^2, b\ne 0$.
